visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a beige long-sleeved sweater and white pants stands in a modern entryway with wooden floors. He holds a white plastic bag of trash in his right hand. He turns to talk to someone off-camera near a dark brown door before exiting. (2) The scene shifts to a public transit environment; the man is seen on a moving escalator, still clutching the white bag. He then walks through a subway ticket gate in a clean, brightly lit station. (3) He is now sitting on a metal bench at an airport or terminal marked 'T2' and 'A13'. He looks weary but maintains his grip on the trash bag. He subsequently boards a modern passenger train. (4) The man is seated by a train window, looking down at a smartphone in his hands. The landscape outside is blurred by motion. He then steps off the train onto a platform. (5) A brief aerial shot through an airplane window shows a coastline with wind turbines and waves. Next, the man is walking through a large outdoor shopping plaza with a sign for 'Mitsui Outlet' visible. (6) He is seated on a high-speed train, leaning his head against the window with his eyes closed as if sleeping, still holding the bag. (7) The man is shown eating at a wooden restaurant table, then picking up a cup of bubble tea from a counter and walking while drinking it, all while still carrying the original white trash bag. (8) He enters a white-walled dance studio and stands before three young women who appear confused or shocked. He gestures with the plastic bag towards them.
